stage.name: Lingering Shangshu Trails
stage.description:
Wares of all shapes and sizes have once again appeared on the twisting mountain paths. Are they seeking the goblet which once granted them sentience, which was subsequently cast from the mountains? The relevant bureaus in Yan have requested Rhodes Island's assistance in this matter.
<Special Conditions>DP will not regenerate naturally.

grindstone.name: Grindstone
grindstone.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. All blades must be sharpened to not lose their edge. A Waregeist of this type tends to be timid and will dash out of harm's way at the first sign of danger.

vernacularism.name: Vernacularism
vernacularism.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. The world is a strange place, but there is joy to be had. A Waregeist of this type is unusually energetic and likes to hang out with other Waregeists.

sophistication.name: Sophistication
sophistication.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. Among its serene mountains and waterscapes, one can be free and enjoy themselves without a care in the world. A Waregeist of this type is quiet and refined, bringing joy to other Waregeists.

brightmirror.name: Brightmirror
brightmirror.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. All blades must be sharpened to not lose their edge. A Waregeist of this type tends to be timid, but often goes the extra mile in an attempt to prove itself.

fountainboil.name: Fountainboil
fountainboil.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. When the water comes to a boil, spreading its fragrance far and wide, none can resist partaking in a cup of tea. A Waregeist of this type can paralyze its foes and slow their attacks.
abilities: Upon death, explodes and deals area Arts damage, greatly reducing allied units' ASPD (can be Resisted)

rainbowbrew.name: Rainbowbrew
rainbowbrew.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. Adding water to wine gets you a less potent drink, while adding water to tea creates a richer beverage. A Waregeist of this type can paralyze its foes and slow their attacks. It is tireless, fighting more gallantly by the minute.
abilities: Upon death, explodes and deals area Arts damage, greatly reducing allied units' ASPD (can be Resisted)

scantwords.name: Scantwords
scantwords.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. Beauty is in the eye of the beholder. A Waregeist of this type can show its opponent their inner secrets in their most relentless, truest form, and is more likely to anger its opponents than other Waregeists.
abilities: More likely to be attacked by allied units

heartbillow.name: Heartbillow
heartbillow.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. The crouching demon and sleeping dragon solemnly stand guard and ward off evil, and though the paperweight was once stately and majestic, it is now anxious and restless, always ready to attack.

inkwave.name: Inkwave
inkwave.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. It is always difficult to put brush to paper, and though the paperweight was once calm and patient, it is now anxious and restless.

introspection.name: Introspection
introspection.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. Beauty is in the eye of the beholder. A Waregeist of this type can show its opponent their inner secrets, and is more likely to anger its opponents than other Waregeists.
abilities: More likely to be attacked by allied units

sinkingsand.name: Sinkingsand
sinkingsand.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. The weaponry dreams of the past, brooding on its utter defeat. A Waregeist of this type holds deep, bottomless grudges, and can be particularly destructive.
abilities: Consumes Broken Blades to gain increased ATK
When defeated, each unconsumed Broken Blade will spawn a <Bronze Spearhead> (minimum 1)

clarity.name: Clarity
clarity.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. Its tiny glimmer can flood its surroundings with light. Other Waregeists are invisible under its radiance, as though shrouded by its blessings.
abilities: Periodically grants temporary Invisibility to surrounding enemy units

sharpedge.name: Sharpedge
sharpedge.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. The weaponry yet again dreams of the past. A Waregeist of this type rouses its old memories as though it is taking to the battlefield again. Its strength is doubled as it and its peers rally each other.
abilities: Consumes Broken Blades to gain increased ATK
When defeated, each unconsumed Broken Blade will spawn a <Iron Spearhead> (minimum 1)

scarletmist.name: Scarletmist
scarletmist.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. Crystalline and adorned with engravings of dragons and phoenixes, a Waregeist of this type is mysterious and imposing in nature, though it is also extremely irritable in temperament and very aggressive.
abilities: After several attacks, inflicts continuous Arts damage that slowly increases over time (can be Resisted)

magnificence.name: Magnificence
magnificence.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. Its tiny glimmer serves as a beacon casting light upon the dark night. A Waregeist of this type not only blesses its peers with its radiance, but is also particularly destructive.
abilities: Periodically grants temporary Invisibility to surrounding enemy units

blueflower.name: Blueflower
blueflower.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. Crystalline and adorned with engravings of dragons and phoenixes, a Waregeist of this type is graceful and sophisticated, though it's hard to say whether that goes for its temperament too.
abilities: After several attacks, inflicts continuous Arts damage that slowly increases over time (can be Resisted)
